name: Haiku price momentum
strategy: Pursue H2 2026 momentum across three stacking themes: mega-cap semiconductor/AI mega-winners (MU, SOXL), leveraged large-cap tech (TQQQ, QQQ), and emerging small-cap outperformance (IWM); rebalance weekly as relative momentum shifts.

positions.thesis: Small-cap outperformance (+19.4% H1) is the new momentum acceleration; IWM is now the market's accelerating theme as capital rotates from mega-cap concentration into breadth.
3x Nasdaq leverage captures core AI and growth momentum; Nasdaq +17.3% H1 run and mega-cap tech leadership continue through H2 as the structural story.
3x semiconductor leverage; +250% H1 surge is extreme momentum; recent correction is a healthy digestion, not a trend break—dips in strong momentum are buys.
Micron's +187% H1 exemplifies mega-cap semiconductor momentum; AI memory infrastructure remains the structural growth driver and momentum leader.
Core Nasdaq-100 ballast; unlevered participation in large-cap tech momentum and AI infrastructure while providing diversification from 3x plays.

outlook: Tech momentum and semiconductor strength dominate H2; small-cap rotation is the emerging secondary theme. Dry powder supports Friday rebalancing as relative momentum shifts within the tech/semis/small-cap complex.
